question: How many car makers are there in each continents? List the continent name and the count.
gold_query: SELECT T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.continent JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.CountryId  =  T3.Country GROUP BY T1.Continent;

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT continents.Continent, COUNT(DISTINCT car_makers.Id) AS car_makers_count FROM continents JOIN countries ON continents.ContId = countries.Continent JOIN car_makers ON countries.CountryId = car_makers.Country GROUP BY continents.Continent"}
